meta.name: caveman
meta.description: Ultra-compressed communication mode that cuts output tokens while keeping technical accuracy. Levels: lite, full, ultra and the wenyan variants. Use for /caveman, "caveman mode", "talk like caveman", "be brief" or "less tokens".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把冗长回复压成极简短句,省字又不丢技术要点。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果嫌 AI 回话啰嗦,想用更少字数抓到关键信息。
copy.tagline_en: Compress long replies into terse lines that keep the technical points.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if replies feel too wordy and you want the key points in fewer words.

howto.what: Claude 此后每次回复都改成极简压缩风格：删掉冠词、客套和啰嗦词，技术内容、数字、代码块与报错原文保持不变。默认 full 档，持续整个会话，直到你说 stop caveman。
howto.when: 当你输入 /caveman，或说「caveman mode」、「be brief」等说法时触发接管。

say.note: 切到 lite 档，保留完整句子。
开启默认 full 档压缩风格。
恢复正常回答，结束压缩。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude answers every reply in ultra-compressed style: drops articles, filler and pleasantries, but keeps technical terms, numbers, code and error strings unchanged. Default level full, persists all session until you say stop caveman.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you type /caveman, or say "caveman mode", "be brief", "less tokens" and similar phrases.

say_en.note: Switch to lite level, full sentences kept.
